divide_label_unlabel: divide dataset dicts into labeled and unlabeled sets using a supervision percentage and pre-generated random seed file
build_detection_semisup_train_loader: build a semi-supervised training data loader from labeled datasets using a detectron2 config and optional mapper
build_detection_test_loader: build a test data loader for evaluation on a named dataset using a detectron2 config
build_detection_semisup_train_loader_two: build a semi-supervised training data loader with separate labeled and unlabeled datasets supporting cross-dataset or supervision modes
build_semisup_batch_data_loader_two_crop: build a batch data loader that groups labeled and unlabeled datasets by aspect ratio for two-crop semi-supervised training
